effect.name: GM Layered Paper Cut
effect.desc: Luminance-sliced paper layers with physical offset shadows, bevel highlights and palette depth.
effect.shader: float lum(vec4 c){return dot(c.rgb,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722));}void main(){vec2 uv=acScreenNorm,sz=max(inputImg.size,vec2(1.0)),off=vec2(cos(angle),sin(angle))*shadowPx/sz;vec4 src=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,uv),back=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(uv-off,0.0,1.0));float lv=max(floor(layers+.5),2.0),a=floor(lum(src)*lv)/lv,b=floor(lum(back)*lv)/lv;float shadow=smoothstep(0.0,1.0/lv,max(b-a,0.0))*shadowStrength;float edge=abs(a-b)*lv;vec3 paper=mix(vec3(a),src.rgb,sourceColor);paper=mix(paper,shadowColor.rgb,shadow);paper+=edge*bevel;gl_FragColor=vec4(mix(src.rgb,paper,mixAmount),src.a);}
